title: Blue Skies
summary:
It's another beautiful day in Toronto, where we're not at all affected by the choices made by the provincial government to cut forest fire-fighting budgets, or federal government policy that underplays concerns around climate change, or America's gutted environmental controls that affect weather patterns across borders. Breathe it all in!

Looking up through Toronto towers to clear blue skies, July, 2026, image by UrbanToron
